spans.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
spans.translation_reference: Al pasar el tiempo, a medida que la incipiente población se va adaptando al nuevo entorno, comienza a asemejarse cada vez menos a la otra población.

spans.reference: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
spans.translation_reference: Los accidentes de avión son habituales en Irán, que tiene una flota antigua que no recibe buen mantenimiento, ya sea para operaciones civiles o militares.

spans.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
spans.translation_reference: En muchos casos, inscribirse en un programa de estudios en el extranjero durante un año sabático puede, en efecto, incrementar las posibilidades de acceder a la educación superior una vez se regresa al país de origen.

spans.reference: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
spans.translation_reference: El islam también fue llevado a las tierras por los árabes y se impuso, en buena medida, en las Comores y Mayotte.

spans.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
spans.translation_reference: Merece la pena dedicar media hora a dar un paseo por el fascinante pueblo.

metric_definitions.speech_end_to_final_ms: last VAD-positive capture frame end to final payload ready; not browser rendering
metric_definitions.e2e_latency_ms: legacy queue submission to translation/QE completion
metric_definitions.true_e2e_ms: legacy first speech observation to translation/QE completion
metric_definitions.silence_delay_ms: legacy first speech observation to queue submission (includes speaking)
metric_definitions.partial_total_ms: STT plus Marian compute only; excludes cadence, queue and delivery

latency_trace.clock_scope: same pipeline process only; not comparable across runs or hosts

final_queue_pressure.scope: final input queue and waiting producers; excludes sentinel, active STT and translation
final_queue_pressure.wait_definition: submission request to dequeue; max includes observed outstanding/cancelled ages
final_queue_pressure.sampling: submit request, successful put, failed put, successful get, summary; no polling

source_coverage.classification_scope: machine VAD/filter/caption decisions; not acoustic truth or approved speech recall

limitations: Headers, hashes and sample counts cannot prove source waveform equality or semantic speech coverage.
Stored final FLOAT32 WAVs are checked; emitted preview audio is not persisted.
Trace covers physical calls, including suppressed previews; truncated traces are unavailable evidence.

measurement_scope: server real-time replay; no physical visibility certification
